entities.name: Copernican Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The paradigm shift from the geocentric Ptolemaic model to the heliocentric model proposed by Nicolaus Copernicus in De revolutionibus orbium coelestium (1543). This revolution in astronomy transformed cosmology and laid the foundation for modern physics.
